(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-border? obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1))
             (w (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1))
             (border-size (- (* h w) (* (max 0 (- h 2)) (max 0 (- w 2))))))
        (and (>= h 3) (>= w 3) (= (obj-size obj) border-size)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (first bb)) (= (first p) (third bb))
                         (= (second p) (second bb)) (= (second p) (fourth bb))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (let* ((frames (filter rect-border? (objects g 0))))
      (if (empty? frames)
          g
          (let* ((frame (first frames))
                 (bb (obj-bbox frame))
                 (with-border (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) (obj-cells frame) (obj-color frame))))
            (for/fold ([out with-border]) ([c (in-range (+ (second bb) 1) (fourth bb))])
              (let ((vals (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0)))
                                  (for/list ([r (in-range (+ (first bb) 1) (third bb))]) (at g r c)))))
                (for/fold ([acc out]) ([v (in-list vals)] [i (in-naturals)])
                  (set-cell acc (+ (first bb) 1 i) c v)))))))))
